common_task_contract.candidate_default: retain current production behavior; isolated experiments only

frozen_rules: GDD v0.70 ordered first-eligible-single-element core, current resonance/conflict and per-card floor
Current health 70/80/100 and existing class-specific shield caps
Natural draw floors, 20-card base deck, 5-card hand, 3-card opening
Existing equipment death loss and economic/drop rules
No automatic activation of Fenxian, Guardian, monster pool, backpack or bot candidates
No red equipment, doom or diamond enablement
Original load profile and stop lines cannot be relaxed to claim capacity improvement

tasks.title: 战斗停滞归因与体验指标
write_scope: tools gameplay telemetry/accounting; client/server hooks by their owners

subtasks.instruction: 冻结战斗关联、配置、策略和种子字段，异步保留发起上下文
区分通信存活、合法机会、有效进展及等待原因
按场景输出有效输出/操作/控制/资源/网络指标
正常终态、弃战、脚本兜底、异常和时限删失分别统计

tasks.acceptance: Long-tail cause attribution and count conservation; missing samples never become success.

tasks.title: 数值合同与CI配套修复

subtasks.instruction: 将旧布尔参数/属性迁移为当前枚举策略及盾余量合同，不删失败测试
真实Resolver覆盖现行GDD向量、顺序、取整、调节及治疗路径
校验预览/协议/结算同输入一致且预览无副作用
核对有效房间policy及快照/PVP/旧版本恢复兼容

tasks.acceptance: Applicable CI actually executes on the integration SHA with current defaults unchanged.

tasks.title: 战斗体验场景与公平对照
write_scope: tools simulation/scenario harness and owned tests

subtasks.instruction: 保留全手原策略，新增只用可见信息的确定性基本/构筑策略
固定三职业同预算构筑和分层种子，覆盖PVE/PVP与极值
计划配对样本与区间，完整记录失败/未结束分母，真人试玩独立
原容量基线与数值候选profile严格分开

tasks.acceptance: Reproducible bounded comparisons; simulated behavior is not represented as verified human experience.

tasks.title: 默认构筑与等牌体验
write_scope: reviewed source configuration; UI by AG-02

subtasks.instruction: 读取真实默认20张，识别脚本打空与构筑缺陷
同品质等级成本单卡替换，禁止暗增初始资源
展示抽牌进度、控制阻断、满手轮空与等待原因
用有效操作、首战结果、凑核和资源守恒共同评估

tasks.acceptance: Initial-budget experience improves without changing draw floors or removing strategic waiting.

tasks.title: PVE长尾与怪物节奏候选
write_scope: only evidence-approved monster source config and experiment profile

subtasks.instruction: 按具体怪物ID复现并区分数值、策略、网络与目标错误
只对白名单长尾执行单因素HP或首意图预告候选
保留Boss/PVP边界，并检查每局及每分钟经济收益
实验前冻结效益/风险阈值，区间不足则继续阻塞

tasks.acceptance: Evidence-based tails improve without hiding flow defects or introducing unexplained economy drift.

tasks.title: 法师返牌资源循环

subtasks.instruction: 复现当前单张同核连携返牌资源路径，不预断全卡池无限循环
复用按真实R返0/0/1/1/2候选，保留既有蓄能合同
暂停自然抽牌测试被动及复合过牌长序列的资源账本
检查三/五核爽感、空等、对位和快照策略一致性

tasks.acceptance: Resource conservation, unchanged default regression and candidate experience evidence before enablement.

tasks.title: 盾职业梯度与余量显示
write_scope: owned Guardian tests; UI by AG-02

subtasks.instruction: 对照当前台阶与10/14/18/22/26/30十分点候选
显式评估+2与+4均值下降，不能称全等级加强
累计5/7/9/11/13/15及满盾、精确填满、预览、重连/PVP边界
显示本次整数盾/有效盾/溢出/余量，不擅改价格退款

tasks.acceptance: No duplicate remainder benefit, no default regression, and explicit affected-level review.

tasks.title: 控制续航与调节牌边际价值
write_scope: owned control/resolver tests; source card candidates only after evidence; UI by AG-02

subtasks.instruction: 验证现有8秒控制递减与实际新增控制时间，不再叠新递减
同品质单卡替换比较五系调节的真实资源/输出/控制
核对调节免P与间接K影响，分离普通治疗和向反回复
显示帽内有效值与浪费，有异常才提单卡/来源候选

tasks.acceptance: Measured marginal value and readable correct caps without unproven blanket nerfs.

tasks.title: 怪物卡池与构筑连续性
write_scope: existing monster pool implementation/tests; client selection by AG-02

subtasks.instruction: 核实有效pool policy并测稀释与关键牌兑现
复用可选吸收3/5/8候选，基础20不删、新牌进弃牌
验证来源、重复、满位替换、入侵/PVP/恢复和终态清理
对比稳定性、打断成本及经济，不自动启用

tasks.acceptance: Pool/instance conservation and candidate benefit with unchanged formal default.

tasks.title: 选牌顺序有效值与操作反馈
write_scope: owned combat UI, localization and tests

subtasks.instruction: 显式顺序/主核及版本绑定预览，禁止隐式重排
展示有效伤害治疗盾/溢出并同步中英说明
本地按下反馈与权威确认分开，禁止幽灵伤害或重复命令
注入目标/手牌变化、重连、帧率和延迟，测分段响应

tasks.acceptance: Ordered authority-consistent previews and responsive, truthful visual states.

tasks.title: 战斗过渡与多局等待
write_scope: owned ready/settlement UI/tests; gateway by AG-03

subtasks.instruction: 分阶段可见等待，依据权威deadline，不编预计完成时间
复用重复NOT_IN_ROOM/旧局回调/ack丢响应修复，保留资产恢复
测到Bootstrap瓶颈再评估轻量查询及单飞，保留安全边界
真实三局另测有渲染交互与小屏，headless不代替体验验收

tasks.acceptance: Readable recoverable waiting and exactly-once assets without animation-blocked legal actions.

tasks.title: 独立验收配置交付
